APRA secures $8 million penalty against Bendigo and Adelaide Bank over cyber incident

The Federal Court has ordered Bendigo and Adelaide Bank (Bendigo Bank) to pay pecuniary penalties totalling $8 million after the bank admitted it had breached its obligations under the Banking Executive Accountability Regime (BEAR) in relation to a 2023 cyber incident.

Diversa pays $1 million penalty under infringement notice issued by APRA

APRA recently issued an infringement notice to Diversa Trustees Limited (Diversa) for allegedly failing to process 10 member rollovers and fund transfers within the timeframes required under the Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Regulations 1994.
